delivery.title: Ibisobanuro vy'ugushikana - {{id}}
delivery.passExplainer: "Pass" aha bisigura gusa ko umukozi w'intumbero yasubije ikibanza ca HTTP 2xx - ntivyemeza ko uburyo bwakira bwabitswe canke bwatunganije umurongozi. Suzuma umubiri w’inyishu uri hejuru ku vyo wavuze mu vy’ukuri; iyo ari ubusa canke gusa kwemera, iyo sisitemu ishobora kuba iriko irakira igisabwa ariko yanka canke yirengagiza umuzigo w'inyungu imbere (amazina/imiterere y'ibibanza bitari vyo ku API yayo , umwanya usabwa ku ruhande rwayo uwo muzigo w'inyungu udashiramwo, n'ibindi).

push.title: Webhooks rwo hanze - Gusunika abarongozi n'ivyavuguruwe
push.intro: Ishobora guhindurwa ku buryo bushitse ku webhook : JSON , Urupapuro (x-www-urupapuro-urlencoded), canke urupapuro rwawe rw'umubiri n'ibimenyetso vy'ibibanza <fieldkey></fieldkey> (nk'akarorero <example></example> ) - bikora nk'ukuzuza itegeko cURL rimwe.
push.curlHelp: Paste akarorero usaba API docs zabo canke Postman aguha (n'amakuru nyayo canke y'akarorero). URL , uburyo n’imitwe bikoporwa nk’uko biri, kandi urufunguzo rwose ruri mu mubiri ruri aha hepfo kugira ngo ushobore guhitamwo umwanya wa CRM uruzuza ku bijanye n’umurongozi wese.
push.curlPrompt: Ufise cURL y'umukiriya ? <action>Injira kuva kuri cURL</action> kugira ngo wuzuze ibi n'ikarita y'ibibanza ubwavyo.
push.headersInvalid: Imitwe itegerezwa kuba ikora JSON , nk'akarorero {{example}}
push.authTitle: Ivyemezo (ingene Leadrat yinjira muri API yabo )
push.modeSame: Wohereze ikintu cose kuri URL imwe
push.modeCreateUpdate: Rema iyo nyandiko rimwe, hanyuma uyihindure iyo nyandiko nyene (nta n'imwe yisubiriza ku ruhande rwabo)
push.responseIdRequired: ID yabo y'inyandiko iri mu nyishu *
push.responseIdHint: Aho ID iri mu nyishu yabo JSON ku bisabwa vyo kurema. Bibitswe ku nzira nka <externalid></externalid> .
push.retriesHint: Ku bijanye n’igihe co guhera, amakosa ya HTTP 429 na 5xx - inyuma y’umunota 1, iminota 5, iminota 30, amasaha 2, amasaha 6.
push.howFilled: Uko agaciro kuzuye: iyi webhook irasubira gukoreshwa ku nzira yose - Leadrat ntiyohereza akarorero kadahinduka, yohereza ugusunika gushasha igihe cose ikintu catoranyijwe kibaye, n'agaciro k'UWO nzira.
push.howFilledStandard: JSON / Form ihita ishiramwo umwanya wose uri ku nzira - ntaco woshiraho.
push.howFilledCustom: Umugenzo - wandike umubiri wawe w'ivyo usaba maze ushiremwo aho hose; buri kimwe cose gihindurwa n’agaciro nyakuri k’ico kirongozi imbere gato y’uko kirungikwa. Fyonda ku mpinduka iri musi kugira ngo uyishiremwo.
push.rawTemplate: Igishushanyo c'umubiri (kidasanzwe) - guhindura utaziguye canke winjize ibihinduka
push.preview: Imbere y'igihe - ivyo mu vy'ukuri bizohereza (akarorero k'uburongozi)
push.previewEmpty: (wandike igishushanyo c'umubiri hejuru kugira ngo ubone imbere y'igihe)
push.resyncTruncated_one: Resync yasunikiye {{total}} wa mbere wa {{count}} (umupaka {{limit}} ku kwiruka). Gabanya urutonde rw’amatariki kugira ngo usunike ibindi.
push.resyncTruncated_other: Resync yasunikiye {{total}} wa mbere wa {{count}} abarongoye (umupaka {{limit}} ku rugendo). Gabanya urutonde rw’amatariki kugira ngo usunike ibindi.
push.syncHelp: Sunika umurongo wose wanditswe muri iyi tariki kandi (siga vyose ataco bimaze kugira ngo usunike vyose).

receive.title: Kwakira - Kwemera uburongozi mu buryo bwose
receive.intro: Inkomoko yose ironka URL yayo . Point Facebook lead ads, Zapier , urupapuro rw'urubuga canke uwundi CRM 's webhook kuri yo - bohereza abarongozi mu buryo bwabo bwite JSON canke urupapuro, nawe ugaca ukora ikarita y'imirima yabo ku yawe.

api.title: API yawe - Ukwinjira mu nzira zibiri kuri sisitemu yose
api.intro: Sisitemu yose ifise urufunguzo rwawe API irashobora kurema, gusoma no guhindura abarongozi no kwiyandikisha ku bikorwa vy'abarongozi. Wohereze urufunguzo mu mutwe <hdr></hdr> , nka <bearer></bearer> , canke (niba igikoresho kidashobora gushinga imitwe) nka <query></query> . Igitigiri: {{limit}} ibisabwa ku munota.
api.noPermission: Umuntu afise uruhusha rwo Gucungera Amagenamiterere ni we wenyene ashobora kubona urufunguzo API .
api.shownOnce: Kopa uru rufunguzo ubu urubike ahantu hatagira umutekano - kubera umutekano rwerekanwa rimwe gusa. Niba yazimiye, ushiremwo iyindi nshasha.
api.regenerateConfirm: Gutanga urufunguzo API rushasha? Urufunguzo ruriho ubu rurahagarika gukora ubwo nyene kuri sisitemu yose irukoresha.
api.openApiHint: Injira OpenAPI mu Postman , Zapier , Make canke n8n kugira ngo ubone iherezo ryose ryiteguye gukoreshwa.
